# Install `settings-page` — Settings Page — adapter-driven shell

> SettingsShell two-column settings surface: section nav (mobile collapses to a Select) + Profile (avatar/name/email/bio), Preferences (theme/language/density), Notifications (switch rows), Danger zone (AlertDialog-confirmed delete).

## 1. Install

```bash
npx rahman-resources add settings-page
# alias: npx rr add settings-page
```

## 2. What it ships

- tags: `settings`, `account`, `profile`, `preferences`, `notifications`, `danger-zone`, `basics`

## 3. Wire it up

Run `npx rr add settings-page`. Implement SettingsAdapter { load, save } over your backend (Convex query + mutation), pass to <SettingsShell adapter>. save receives per-section partial patches — shallow-merge server-side. onDeleteAccount callback wires the danger zone.

## Rules of engagement

- shadcn-only UI primitives. No raw `<button>` / `<dialog>` / native date or file inputs.
- 200-line hard cap per source file (extract neighbours when over).
- All Convex queries hit an index (`.withIndex(...)`); never bare `.collect()`.
- Public mutations/queries declare `args:` validators + authz.
